title: Lover's Ledger
tagline: Relationship and encounter statistics ledger for SkyrimNet character bios.
description:
## What this mod does?

Tracks OStim interactions between npcs and record all ositm related information: npcs encounters, lovers, positions, etc... Caluclates based on data scores for lovers.

## How does it integrates with SkyrimNet?

It adds a few context pieces to tell SkyrimNet npc's sexual history, their lovers and npc's preferences like if they prefer couple encounters, group encounters, sexual preferences, etc...
author: tetherball88
changelog:
Thanks to goodprovider(@wind) Lover's Ledger now has:
- **Full SexLab AE & P+ support**: `TTLL_SexlabIntegration` now records SexLab scenes into the same ledger fields as OStim (using collector thread IDs `-1` to `-15`), maps SexLab acts to OStim action names via `synonyms.json`, syncs OStim encounters into SexLab's counters, backfills pre-existing SexLab history on first sight (`LLPL`), tracks first-time milestones (`DescribeFirstTimes` / `LLPT`), and supports `SkyrimNet_SexLab` OrgasmEngine weighted orgasm attribution.
